The Gorgias API is structured with REST in mind. Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs. On this page, you'll find the complete REST API reference, examples, definitions of objects, and guides. 🚫 Resources, resources' attributes, and resources' operations not documented in this documentation should not be used and should be considered as non-existing. They are reserved for internal use and can be changed or removed at any time without prior notice. You should not rely on them at any time. 🗞 Developer Newsletter Please sign up for our monthly developer newsletter if you start using our API. Jump to Content Home Quickstart API Reference Changelog Quickstart Home Quickstart API Reference Changelog Private vs. Public App Introduction Private vs. Public App Authentication Access Tokens (API Keys) OAuth2 Bearer Token OAuth2 Scopes Building a Public App Overview Building a high-quality Gorgias app 1. Register on Developer Portal & Get Gorgias Sandbox Account 2. Create a Draft App submission form 3. Set up OAuth2 4. Build and test your app 5. Submit app for review 6. Stay in touch Tutorials OAuth2 authentication for creating apps with Gorgias Create a ticket using API Create a new message in ticket via API Integrate with a new channel Create integrations and widgets Show 3rd-party data in tickets Sync Gorgias data with a database How to attach Gorgias tracking data to Shopify Cart and Checkout attributes Refresh Shopify Cart’s UI on Updates via Convert Powered by Private vs. Public App Understand the difference between the two types and decide which one better fits your goals. Before you start creating your first Gorgias app you need to choose between two types of apps: 🔐 Private apps These apps should be used if you plan to access only your own Gorgias account data. You don't need to follow any special process to create a private app. For the authentication method, you can use Access Tokens . 👥 Public apps These apps are published in our App Store and are available to thousands of shop owners. You need to follow a specific process which includes a review from the Gorgias team. 👉 Public app authentication can be done only via OAuth2 for which you will need to register on our Developer portal . If your Gorgias domain is green-garden , your base API URL is: https://green-garden.gorgias.com/api/ . E.g: to fetch the details of your account, you will query: GET https://green-garden.gorgias.com/api/account/ Partially updating objects When performing updates on objects (e.g: updating a ticket, a customer), you don't have to send all its attributes. Just send the attributes you want to modify. This will prevent overriding some other attributes in the case the data you fetched were outdated.
